message.reasoning_content: No open description tasks; but I can add a quantitative refinement for the risk_map to help Experimenter size the error. Let me estimate: h grows ~0.01·t → ~6.4 at t=640. Per-step fp16 rounding error ~ h·2^-11 ~ up to ~0.003 absolute per step, random-walk accumulated: total error ~ sum of per-step errors accumulated with a=1 (each error persists undamped). Error at step t = sum of previous rounding errors, each ~ h(s)·2^-11 ~ 0.01·s·2^-11. Sum over s ~ 0.01·t²/2·2^-11 ~ 0.01·640²/2/2048 ~ 2.0. Relative error per element at t: err/h ~ sum(s·0.01·2^-11)/(0.01·t) = t/(2·2048) ~ 0.156 at t=640 — way above 0.003. Actually errors random walk sign, so more like sqrt, but bias in rounding? Still, per-element relative error at large t ~ t·2^-11/2 ~ 0.15 — far above budget. So deterministic analysis strongly suggests violation. Record description update with this quantitative estimate, noting random signs reduce it somewhat but likely far above 0.003.
